viewport.note: set via CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride on both p1 (Todoist) and p2 (meologue); the override was found to reset between separate ego-browser nodejs invocations and was re-applied and re-verified immediately before this measurement on each page

method: Disposable task 'ZZ probe detail' opened in both apps' detail view; document.getAnimations().forEach(a=>a.finish()) run before measuring; two reads 150ms apart on the dialog's getBoundingClientRect and getComputedStyle.

meologue.note: The extra rgba(0,0,0,0) box-shadow layers are unused ring/offset layers from the shadow utility stack; the final rendered layer, rgba(0,0,0,0.16) 0px 2px 8px 0px, is byte-identical to Todoist's.

verdict.note: 864x708 in both apps, two stable reads each, at the required 1470x836 viewport. Round 2 (and flow 5 originally) read meologue at 864x710.594 at this same viewport; the height formula min(772px, 100vh-128px) now yields 836-128=708, exactly matching Todoist's own formula's output at this viewport. Radius (10px), background (rgb(31,31,31)) and the visible shadow layer are identical. meologue's computed border is '0px solid rgb(61,61,61)' vs Todoist's '0px none rgb(255,255,255)' -- both are effectively no border (0px width) and were already recorded as matching in flow 4/5; the color difference is inert since width is 0.
